title: Automating Clinic Intake: How to Build Revenue Systems with Claude #Shorts
description:
How clinic owners use Claude and n8n to automate after-hours intake while ensuring strict HIPAA and GDPR compliance by masking patient identifiers.

1. Connect web form or WhatsApp booking triggers to n8n automation workflows
2. Send incoming inquiry text to Claude API to parse urgency level and extract appointment details without storing health data
3. Update clinic calendar slots and trigger automated SMS appointment reminders

Tool used:
- name: Claude API
- endpoint: Analyze this appointment enquiry text: extract preferred date and service needed. Mask patient names, personal identifiers, and medical notes.
- docs: Anthropic API Documentation

prompt_template.json (json) - n8n Claude node system prompt:
{
  "task": "extract_appointment",
  "instructions": "Extract date and service. Explicitly mask patient names, personal identifiers, and medical notes to ensure PHI compliance.",
  "input": "{{inquiry_text}}"
}

The catch: Protected health information (PHI) must never be passed to unencrypted public LLMs; keep patient data anonymized.

Sources for the numbers:
- aibusiness.vc reports on AI intake workflow pricing
- infoq.com report on Claude Code practitioners

Real ways to earn with AI, no hype - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE5va3NCQ1NINmlOLW0yNmdUZzRnQzAyMjMyRmpNdURMbDRicFR5VkZpclNlY2c1V1BKdTQyNGpZNXJ6WGJnM3FoR3hLNGFHQ2Fxdm9Zblh2UjJNTVVwMUhzTGNJcFZyQXd6?oc=5

angle.problem: Clinic owners lose thousands in monthly revenue to high patient no-shows and unhandled after-hours intake messages.
angle.solution: Deploy an automated intake and SMS reminder workflow that qualifies patient queries and books appointments into clinic software.
steps: Connect web form or WhatsApp booking triggers to n8n automation workflows
Send incoming inquiry text to Claude API to parse urgency level and extract appointment details without storing health data
Update clinic calendar slots and trigger automated SMS appointment reminders
angle.api: Analyze this appointment enquiry text: extract preferred date, service needed, and contact details. Do not provide medical diagnostics.
angle.numbers: aibusiness.vc reports custom AI intake workflows sell for $3,000-$10,000 build fees plus $500-$2,000/month retainers.
angle.catch: Protected health information (PHI) must never be passed to unencrypted public LLMs; keep patient data anonymized.
angle.result: Clinic founders reduce missed calls and patient no-shows while maintaining compliance.
angle.wow: Capture missed after-hours patient bookings completely automatically without adding night-shift staff.
